postconditions.description: The return value is a string.

postconditions.expression: return_value == '' if not any(char in arg2 for char in arg1) else max(lcs_recursive(arg1, arg2, i, j) for i in range(len(arg1) + 1) for j in range(len(arg2) + 1))
postconditions.description: The return value is the longest common subsequence of the two input strings. If there is no common subsequence, an empty string is returned.
